thread:
jack_cs: FYI — LumenCart submitted a request to onboard a custom multimodal product-describer for personalization + returns QA. They flagged PHI/PII avoidance and hallucination concerns. Can we triage?
emily_se: thanks for the ping. do we have a short spec or sample inputs from LumenCart? :eyes:
jack_cs: yes, they shared sample product images + copy and a small test set (2k examples). Key asks: private deployment (VPC), HSM for keys, hallucination <1%, support for image+text inputs, and latency p50 < 220ms for single-turn queries.
deepset_ml: pinging infra constraints — model is their fine-tuned 13B variant, quantized is acceptable. also asking for eval metrics: BLEU/ROUGE for copy, and a hallucination check (fact-check pass rate).
maya_prod: renewal note — LumenCart is up for renewal in 3 months. last renewal had concerns about latency spikes; this onboarding could be a renewal driver but also a risk if we miss SLOs. we should prioritize enablement and a performance-runbook for them.
liam_infra: infra note — for private deploy with HSM we'll need a small dedicated pool or dedicated nodes behind our private control plane. ballpark: 2x A10G equiv for staging, 3x for prod at expected QPS. also need to confirm ONNX vs native runtime.
emily_se: can they tolerate a canary? propose: start on private dev env -> perf eval -> canary on dedicated -> prod roll. Also need a safety eval harness for hallucination tests.
jack_cs: copying LumenCart request snippet here from their intake:```yaml
customer: LumenCart
project: multimodal-product-describer
model: lumen-describer-13b-ft
deployment: private
security: VPC, HSM, SOC2-in-scope
quantization: q4_0
max_tokens: 512
metrics: p50_latency_ms, hallucination_rate, copy_fidelity
ci_dataset_size: 2000
canary_policy: 5% traffic for 48h then 25% for 24h
```
jack_cs: they also asked for an enablement session for 4 engineers + 2 PMs — walkthrough of prompts, caching, and batching.
emily_se: proposed checklist: 1) confirm data sharing & redaction policy 2) schedule infra sizing + HSM integration 3) run safety evals (hallucination 2k set) 4) perf tests and cost estimate 5) enablement session.
maya_prod: i can lead the renewal comms. suggest tying acceptance criteria to their renewal discount (if SLOs met get X% off). keeps them motivated.
liam_infra: action: I can spin staging nodes and run a smoke perf test. need the model artifact URL and expected max QPS.
deepset_ml: action: i'll prepare an eval harness and example scripts. can we ask them for a small reference dataset of edge cases (returns, warranty claims, sensitive personal info in copy)?
jack_cs: i'll request the artifact + edge-case dataset and ask to confirm the enablement window. setting tentative date: next Wed 10am PT.
emily_se: SGTM. Also recommend we add a behavior-monitoring alert for hallucination regression post-deploy.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: new staging environment requested: env-lumencart-stg queued (ETA ~3h). :white_check_mark:
jack_cs: thanks all — i'll follow up with LumenCart and post the model artifact here when they share. tagging @deepset_ml @liam_infra for next steps. :thumbsup:
